name: TradeOff
tagline: A risk-free stock-market simulation game where young investors race to beat the market.

awards: Amazon: AWS Campus Champions - Best Use of DynamoDB Streams

problem: Financial literacy is a gap for young adults, and textbook learning feels abstract.
solution: Gamified market simulation with real market dynamics and practice trading, without real money.
demo_moment: Team-described: join a game and try to beat the market over simulated time.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Amazon: AWS Campus Champions - Best Use of DynamoDB Streams” among 261 submissions.
Practice without the fear of losing money.

lessons: Games make dry financial skills practicable.
